description: The element path a finding's stable id is made of (RB-094-10): the lower-case tag names from `html` down to the element, joined by ' > ', a step numbered ':nth-of-type(n)' (1-based) only when its parent holds more than one child of that tag; no ids, no classes; a shadow root crossed with ' >>> ' after its host's path. The target is the element with `data-target`. Every implementation is held to these cases: plugins/web-common/src/element-path.ts (every TypeScript bundle), plugins/schema-org/src/path.rs (Rust, also plugins/seo through its re-export) and the page copy in plugins/seo/src/collect.js. Cases with `shadow: true` need a live DOM (a declarative shadow root, attached by the TypeScript tests); the Rust parser sees no shadow roots and skips them.

cases.name: body is one step below html
the head's children are numbered too
a tag is numbered among its own tag only, 1-based
the first of several is numbered and ids and classes are ignored
siblings of other tags do not count
text and comments do not count
custom elements are numbered like any tag
camel-case SVG tags are written in lower case
a deep path numbers each level on its own
cases.path: html > body > main:nth-of-type(1) > article > section:nth-of-type(2) > div > a:nth-of-type(2)

cases.name: a shadow root is crossed with >>> after its host's path
nested shadow roots are crossed one after the other
cases.path: html > body > x-a >>> div > x-b >>> i:nth-of-type(2)
